content:
A similar clash exists. Please use another idea for your contribution.

https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/70668541f264aae4e22a49217f6fd8951566a

A write statement should be added to the stub generator.

Also, note that each test and its corresponding validator work as a pair, covering the same scenario with slightly different inputs and outputs. You don't have to renumber the cases.

Thanks.
